definitions.S: S_g+S_t+S_l; fresh real external honest sources and simulated sources both count, cached bytes do not
definitions.g_setup_selected: 0; correct conditioned setup is an explicit premise, not certified entropy/trapdoor secrecy
definitions.g_aff: clip(S*(3*p-2)/(p*p)); deliberately conservative overlap with identity collisions
definitions.root_failure: clip(128*N_honest_prepared/q); conditional fresh uniform query; not a privacy term
definitions.two_world_privacy: clip(e_X_world0+e_X_world1); at most clip(2*e_X) under common bounds
definitions.k_info: clip(G5_ext/2^32), G5_ext external candidate-key U5 queries <= Q5_total
definitions.k_tag: min(k_info,Adv_SHA256_OW128(T_ow,Q_sha+G5_ext,B_sha+16*G5_ext)); without explicit OW premise use k_info

primitive_games.SHA256: single-function collision resistance; all types/messages/bytes in one account per endpoint
primitive_games.signature: per actual unknown honest key EUF-CMA; sign operations/message bytes; malicious or disclosed keys excluded
primitive_games.commitment: five-domain Pedersen binding on subgroup ell; two different canonical messages/openings yield one generator discrete logarithm
primitive_games.HPKE: single-shot Base X25519/HKDF-SHA256/AES-128-GCM labelled IND-CCA2; exact key/suite/info/AAD/enc/payload challenge tuple excluded; legal other tuples decrypt normally
primitive_games.SHA256_OW128: Explicit additional optional primitive assumption, not implied by CR: K uniform16B, full H(K) challenge, return any16B full preimage. Reduction gives only prefix96 to underlying attacker and checks all external U5 candidates with fullhash; no candidate-index guessing loss.

mechanical_scope: Exact finite arithmetic, source-contract consistency, meaningful omission controls. Written proofs and independent semantic review remain necessary. No native campaign/prover/TLC or performance measurement runs here.
origin_count: N_RID counts all honest RID draws/origin reservations including refused ones never sharded; distinct from N_shard
native_query_namespace: Q1 through Q7 are source XOF usages; separate units and inputs from generic group-output counts

key_tag_branches.information_only: No new hash assumption: per key-hop <=min(1,G5_ext/2^32), can be weak or vacuous
key_tag_branches.OW128_corollary: Ordinary explicit SHA256 random-128-bit-input preimage advantage, resources include entire simulation and one extra SHA call/16B per external candidate; use min with information bound
key_tag_branches.P_privacy: Key may be known; fresh honest nonce programming remains Q5/W, no factor2^96
